name: Mornington Coastal Walk
signature: A flat bay foreshore walk past the iconic bathing boxes — Mornington's most pleasant morning ritual
editorNote:
The Mornington Coastal Walk follows the bay foreshore from Mornington Main Beach south toward Mount Martha — a flat, paved path with the bay on one side and the escarpment and Norfolk pines on the other. The bathing boxes at the Main Beach end are the natural starting point; the walk extends as far as you want to take it.

This is the Peninsula's most accessible walking experience — flat, paved, no navigation required, cafes at both ends. Best early morning before the beach crowd arrives, or late afternoon when the light on the bay turns golden. The 4km section from the main beach to Mount Martha North is the most rewarding.
whyWeGo: The Peninsula's most civilised morning walk — flat, coastal, and the bathing boxes at dawn.
ifOnlyOneThing: Start at the main beach at 7am, walk south to Mount Martha, turn around and have breakfast at Commonfolk.

heroImage.alt: Mornington Coastal Walk — bathing boxes and bay foreshore

walk.distance: 4km one way (Mornington to Mt Martha North)
